repos_data.description: A free and open-source collection of native macOS menu bar tools.
Type an app name, press Enter, all its windows come to you. Per-app window control, app launcher, and workspace management for macOS.
Minimalist macOS OCR tool. Open-source, privacy-first, and built with SwiftUI.
Feature-packed native macOS screenshot & recording tool: annotate, auto-redact PII, record GIFs, OCR + translate, scroll capture, beautify, and more. No Electron, no subscription.

⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
A free, open-source macOS window manager. Magnet-compatible keyboard shortcuts + drag-snap.

macOS 鼠标/触控板手势自定义工具。按住该手势的触发键（默认右键，也可中键 / 侧键）绘制轨迹，匹配后执行快捷键、打开应用、窗口操作、媒体键、Shell / AppleScript 等 ｜ A macOS mouse gesture customization tool. Hold down the trigger key to execute shortcuts, open applications, shell/AppleScript, etc. after matching.
Open-source screenshot and screen recording for macOS. The free, native alternative to CleanShot X. Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI.
An open-source native macOS screenshot and screen recording app. A CleanShot X alternative.
A native macOS app for managing Apple's container - build images, run machines, and tail logs from a real GUI.
Native macOS menu bar app — tmux session manager, Keep Awake / closed-lid mode (lid shut, work running), long-running script launcher (OCI polling, capacity wait, backups). Swift + SwiftUI.

repo_meta_data.description: A native, local macOS toolbox for screenshots, OCR, measuring, keep-awake, pointer tools, shortcuts, windows, workspaces, voice and MCP.
